[{"proname":"match_catalogue_image_vectors","arguments":"p_query_embedding halfvec, p_embedding_model text, p_embedding_model_version text, p_preprocess_version text, p_embedding_profile text, p_match_count integer","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_catalogue_image_vectors(p_query_embedding halfvec, p_embedding_model text, p_embedding_model_version text, p_preprocess_version text, p_embedding_profile text, p_match_count integer DEFAULT 30)\n RETURNS TABLE(record_id text, asset_type text, object_key text, similarity double precision, hole_count integer, aspect_ratio real, hole_centroids jsonb)\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT\n    v.record_id,\n    v.asset_type,\n    v.object_key,\n    1 - (v.embedding <=> p_query_embedding) AS similarity,\n    COALESCE(v.hole_count, 0) AS hole_count,\n    COALESCE(v.aspect_ratio, 1.0) AS aspect_ratio,\n    COALESCE(v.hole_centroids, '[]'::jsonb) AS hole_centroids\n  FROM public.catalogue_image_vectors v\n  WHERE v.is_active = true\n    AND v.embedding_model = p_embedding_model\n    AND v.embedding_model_version = p_embedding_model_version\n    AND v.preprocess_version = p_preprocess_version\n    AND v.embedding_profile = p_embedding_profile\n  ORDER BY v.embedding <=> p_query_embedding\n  LIMIT GREATEST(\n    1,\n    LEAST(COALESCE(p_match_count, 30), 100)\n  );\n$function$\n"}]
